plan noun

of action

also strategy, make plans, make plans for the trip, plan a trip, form a plan

classical

Traupman 360

cōnsilium, cōnsiliī n.

noun, second declension

plan, intention or design

Other words

  • cōnsilium capere — make a plan, form a plan, decide

    phrase: dē with the ablative of what is planned, or ut with the subjunctive · also used · classical · Caes. BG 3.2: id acciderat, ut Gallī cōnsilium caperent (Lewis & Short s.v. accidō); Traupman 105: to make plans for the trip, cōnsilium capere dē itinere

Examples

  • Quid dē hōc cōnsiliō putās?

    What do you think of this plan?composed

  • Cōnsilium investīgātiōnis

    a research plan (a descriptive phrase)composed

  • Cōnsilium capiāmus dē itinere.

    Let’s make plans for the trip.Traupman 105

  • cōnsilium inīre

    to form a planTraupman 360

  • cōnsilium capere dē itinere

    to make plans for the tripTraupman 360
